FAQ

Luna questions, answered.

What is Luna?

Luna is an AI booking agent for clinics, gyms, yoga and pilates studios, spas and salons in Dubai and worldwide. It answers enquiries on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and your website, books appointments and classes, and follows up to keep members coming back.

Does Luna give medical or health advice?

No. Luna answers questions about your services, prices, schedules and bookings. Any medical or personal health question is handed to your staff.

Can Luna connect to my booking software?

Luna can send bookings to Google Calendar, Google Sheets or your team on WhatsApp, and connect to many booking tools through a webhook. Tell us which software you use and we will confirm the setup.

Does Luna help with renewals?

Yes. Luna follows up after trial classes and nudges members before their package or membership runs out.

Which languages does Luna speak?

Arabic, English and 100+ more. It replies in the language the client writes in.

Can my team take over a conversation?

Yes. Your team sees every conversation and can reply at any time.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call.

How much does Luna cost?

Starter, Growth and Scale have fixed monthly prices shown on this page, with a one-time setup fee on monthly plans. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise is quoted based on your volume and integrations.
